snippet.title: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute brings this fantastic fantasy card-battling boardgame hybrid to the West for the very first time!

Discover the roots of this legendary series and get the full Culdcept First experience with added QOL!
Coming to Nintendo Switch, PS5  and Xbox Series X|S on September 8th and available for PC on July 30th!

The physical version is now available for pre-order over on the Clear River Games store!: 
https://shop.clearrivergames.com/collections/culdcept-the-first-saturn-tribute

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3825600/Culdcept_The_First_Saturn_Tribute/

Follow Clear River Games on X for updates: http://www.x.com/clearrivergames
